# Halcyon Visuals — Roadmap

Goal: a Vibrant Visuals pack for the latest Minecraft Bedrock release (26.60, pinned to
`Mojang/bedrock-samples@v1.26.60.5`) whose look competes with Java's best shader packs
(Complementary + Euphoria Patches, Rethinking Voxels): saturated skies, long golden hours,
readable blue nights, god rays, living water and per-block PBR.

**Approach:** an official, data-driven Vibrant Visuals resource pack, generated by a Python
build tool from one style definition. It works on every platform that has Vibrant Visuals
(Windows, Xbox, PlayStation, Switch 2, iOS, Android) and survives game updates. Custom
shader code (BetterRenderDragon injection) is Windows-only and unofficial, so it is a late,
optional research phase, not the foundation. See `docs/design.md`.

Status legend: ✅ done · 🔨 in progress · ⏳ planned · 🔬 research

## Phase 0 — Foundation ✅
- ✅ Python generator (`halcyon/`) + CLI: `python -m halcyon build`
- ✅ Validation of every value against Mojang's documented ranges (build fails on bad data)
- ✅ Pinned vanilla reference fetch (`tools/fetch_vanilla.sh`)
- ✅ `.mcpack` packaging, deterministic UUIDs per preset, generated pack icon
- ✅ Tests (pytest) + GitHub Actions build that uploads the `.mcpack` files

## Phase 1 — Light & Atmosphere ✅
Override every vanilla Vibrant Visuals identifier, so every biome gets the new look.
- ✅ Lighting: shaped sun curve, long golden hour, tilted sun path, blue moonlight, colored emissives
- ✅ Atmospherics: deep blue zenith, sunset/sunrise mie glow, pink-purple twilight, navy nights, moon halo
- ✅ Color grading: split-tone (warm highlights, cool shadows), saturation/contrast, tonemapper per preset
- ✅ Volumetric fog: forward-scattering god rays, height falloff, biome profiles (swamp mist, desert dust, jungle humidity, dark-forest shafts)
- ✅ Water: waves on, stronger caustics, clearer tropical tint, biome water color contribution
- ✅ Biome families (temperate, cool, cold, warm, hot, desert, mesa, swamps, dark forest, pale garden, mushroom, ice spikes, lush caves) + Nether/End derived from vanilla
- ✅ Presets: **Vibrant** (default) and **Cinematic**
- ✅ Preview renderer (`python -m halcyon preview`) for sky/sun curves without the game

## Phase 2 — Integrated PBR ✅
Vanilla 26.60 authors MERS (metal, roughness, subsurface, light-source emissive) for every
block but normal maps for only 4 of 1,293. Shipped as a separate **Halcyon PBR** add-on so the
atmosphere presets still stack with any texture pack.
- ✅ Procedural heightmaps for 1,289 blocks from their color textures (Complementary-style "integrated PBR")
- ✅ Material rules table: flat (glass, concrete, wool), foliage, rough (stone, logs, ores), bricks by saturation, raised ore specks
- ✅ Glowing ores (diamond, emerald, lapis, redstone, gold, copper, iron, quartz); `--no-glowing-ores` to opt out
- ✅ Contact-sheet preview (`docs/previews/pbr.png`)
- ⏳ In-game check of heightmap strength and ore glow level (moved to Phase 3 tuning pass)
- ⏳ Optional higher-detail normals (2× upscaled height with smoothing) if in-game results look too blocky

## Phase 3 — Biome Water & In-Game Tuning ⏳
- ⏳ Per-biome water (murky swamps, clear tropical oceans, frozen seas) via generated client_biome files
- ⏳ Custom caustics texture
- ⏳ In-game tuning pass with a screenshot checklist (noon, golden hour, night, rain, caves, each family, PBR strength, ore glow)

## Phase 4 — Presets & UX ⏳
- ⏳ Verify subpacks work for Vibrant Visuals configs; if so, ship one pack with preset selector
- ⏳ Fantasy preset, low-fog performance preset
- ⏳ Store pages (CurseForge / MCPEDL / Modrinth), screenshots, changelog

## Phase 5 — PC "Ultra" layer 🔬
Effects JSON cannot express (custom clouds, colored light bounce à la Rethinking Voxels,
custom shadow filtering, DoF). Requires BetterRenderDragon + compiled RenderDragon materials;
Windows only, breaks on updates. Go/no-go after a spike.

## Known limits of the official route
Not configurable through Vibrant Visuals data today: clouds, bloom/DoF/motion blur,
colored voxel light propagation, rain puddles/wetness, aurora. Track new Mojang creator
docs each release; adopt new knobs as they ship.
